title: Bare / Expo / React Native Android compatibility spike
approved_scope: Android-only Expo SDK 56 / React Native 0.85 Bare-worklet compatibility proof.
Task-local Android SDK/NDK/emulator configuration and a reproducible Java decision only when Android build evidence requires it.
The allowed dependency/configuration, bridge, test, generated-Android, and P0 evidence paths from the task ledger.
excluded_scope: iPhone/iOS support, generated iOS project files, Xcode configuration, and CocoaPods use.
Hyperdrive, HyperSwarm, DHT/networking, media replication, local HTTP, backend/API/database changes, identities, keys, invitations, or product UI.
Global Gradle installation unless the generated Android project proves it indispensable.
acceptance: HP-1: an Android native development build starts the Bare worklet and initialize then ping returns pong.
HP-2: shutdown releases the bridge and the Android app typechecks/builds.
EC-1 and EC-2: worklet failures are typed and contained; malformed or late replies and shutdown-before-ready retain no stale handle.
current_evidence: RRI recomputed at 54 after the Android-only direction; no penalties.
Android SDK platforms 34/36, NDK 27.1.12297006, CMake 3.22.1, emulator 36.6.11, and Android 34 ARM64 system image exist under /opt/homebrew/share/android-commandlinetools.
The host default Java is 26.0.1 whereas the upstream Bare Expo guide documents Java 23; package and build proof remain unresolved.
No Bare package, generated Android project, or P0 source module exists yet.
Phase-1 and phase-2 peer review are explicitly waived only for MVP0-P2P by the repository owner; ADR-038 refinement remains required.
constraints: Use an in-worklet error boundary and typed IPC failure to contain errors because upstream says unhandled worklet failures abort the host process.
Preserve the existing mobile app and reuse its Expo/RN runtime rather than replace product modules.
Stop with evidence if Android native proof cannot be made compatible or bounded.
